newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - mogas up but others slip.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - mogas up but others slip.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday. Gasoline ended slightly higher but the arbitrage to the U.S. appeared to close.
Gas oil outright prices were sharply weaker with speculation over a possible squeeze on prompt prices dulling already thin buying interest.
Heavy fuel prices slipped $2 a tonne in northwest Europe due to weaker Rotterdam barges, but cargoes were thin. Rotterdam barges dipped to trade at $96 fob.
